title: The Residual Book
author: win-opus-5
freeze_rule: A frozen design goes to the OPERATOR for review, never straight to code. No trading-system code is written until he authorises it in words. The bar: state of the art, through the literature and the experiments, until thinking harder stops adding anything.
claim: An altcoin book carries beta = rho * (sigma_alt / sigma_BTC) units of Bitcoin, and that exposure is driven by a VOLATILITY RATIO, not by a regime break. On a fixed universe rho has been stable at 0.68-0.81 for eight years while the vol ratio moved from 1.12 to 1.70. In 2025 Bitcoin's volatility compressed to 0.0219 daily while altcoin volatility stayed at 0.0355, so the ratio hit 1.697 - its highest on record - and an unhedged long-only alt book silently became a 1.35x long on Bitcoin without anything about altcoins changing.
loser: Whoever buys an altcoin for a narrative reason is buying rho * sigma_alt / sigma_BTC units of Bitcoin they did not price. They cannot see the size of it because it is a ratio of two volatilities, not a number on a screen, and it grew 45% between 2024 and 2025 while they held the same position. This book sells them that beta and keeps the residual.

kills.detail: PARTLY ANSWERED by R05: on a fixed universe of five names listed before 2019, the 2025 beta elevation survives. It is real. What did NOT survive is the interpretation - the rise is in the vol ratio, not in rho. H1 still stands with a better universe than five names.

kills.what: The residual is not positive often enough
kills.detail: Hedged residual returns must be positive in at least 7 of 9 calendar years under some admissible signal. The mandate is a minimum +30% every year; an architecture that cannot clear zero most years cannot host it.

kills.what: The hedge costs more than the residual pays
kills.detail: The short Bitcoin leg pays funding when funding is positive, and rebalances as beta drifts. If carry plus turnover exceeds the mean residual, no signal rescues it.

kills.what: The residual is not independent of the factor
kills.detail: If past-estimated beta fails to neutralise future returns, the book is a directional bet wearing a hedge, which is worse than an honest directional bet.

kills.what: The vol ratio is not forecastable
kills.detail: The design now depends on beta being predictable because it is a persistent volatility ratio rather than a break. If sigma_alt/sigma_BTC has no persistence at the hedge's rebalance horizon, the hedge is always stale and K3 fires through the back door.

homework.title: Does the premise survive on a bigger fixed universe?
homework.task: R05 answered this on five names: 2025 beta 1.346 is outside the 0.754-1.220 range of the other years, rho stays inside its range, the vol ratio is outside. Redo it properly: per-year fixed sets by observed_start rather than one 2019 cutoff, beta AND rho AND sigma_alt/sigma_BTC each with uncertainty. The question is no longer 'is beta up' but 'is rho flat', because that is what decides whether Giller's isotropic reading holds on OUR universe.
homework.reject: If rho is materially elevated in 2025 once measured properly, the arithmetic reading is wrong and the regime story comes back. If beta is not elevated at all, K1 fires.

homework.title: Is the residual ownable?
homework.task: Build the residual per symbol from causal rolling beta. Report per calendar year its mean, its dispersion, and its realised OUT-OF-SAMPLE correlation to the Bitcoin return. No signal, no positions.
homework.reject: If out-of-sample |corr(residual, r_BTC)| stays materially above zero, K4 fires and the architecture fails before any signal is chosen.

homework.title: What does the hedge cost?
homework.task: Price the short Bitcoin leg from the funding series on disk: annualised carry per year 2018-2025, plus turnover implied by beta drift at monthly and weekly rebalance. Separately: does published crypto work test RESIDUAL momentum or reversal, or only price momentum?
homework.reject: If hedge carry plus rebalancing exceeds a plausible residual mean, K3 fires and no signal rescues it.

homework.title: Is the volatility ratio persistent enough to hedge on?
homework.task: Autocorrelation and half-life of sigma_alt/sigma_BTC at daily and weekly horizons, per year. The design needs beta to be forecastable; a ratio that mean-reverts faster than the rebalance interval makes every hedge stale on arrival.
homework.reject: If the ratio has no useful persistence at the rebalance horizon, K5 fires.
